subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should the remaining ordinary same-session visible-message fix follow PR #89238's admission-layer approach, be limited to explicit control commands, or split by channel?
rationale: The remaining behavior is not a one-line bug fix: it decides how ordinary visible channel messages interleave with active reply operations, terminal-session recovery, and fallback delivery across channels.

options.title: Refresh PR #89238
options.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer PR on current main, preserve #98126 and #89045 behavior, and fix accepted-queue fallback semantics before merge.

options.title: Limit To Explicit Controls
options.body: Document that only explicit controls such as /steer, /tell, /queue, status, and stop bypass busy lanes while ordinary visible text continues to wait.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Track Telegram, Discord, WebChat, iMessage, and other ingress paths separately if they need different safe admission boundaries.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR #89238
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer PR on current main, preserve #98126 and #89045 behavior, and fix accepted-queue fallback semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the adjacent terminal-session recovery that the candidate admission fix must preserve, making them the best available owner for this decision.
